repos_data.description: 🤖 AI Gateway | AI Native API Gateway
The AI-native database built for LLM applications, providing incredibly fast hybrid search of dense vector, sparse vector, tensor (multi-vector), and full-text.

AI-native ontology engine: a Rust MCP server with tools for building, validating, querying, and reasoning over RDF/OWL ontologies. In-memory Oxigraph triple store, native OWL2-DL tableaux reasoner, SHACL validation, SPARQL, versioning. Single binary, no JVM.
Ship features 10x faster. Built In Auto: Memory, K8S Agent & Security (SDD+SDLC) . 😇

Official MCP server for Frihet ERP — 157 tools for AI-powered invoicing, tax & e-invoicing compliance (VeriFactu, TicketBAI, Facturae), banking, CRM, HR/payroll & POS. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Antigravity, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI — and any MCP-compatible client.
MCP server for project memory — AI agents record decisions, pitfalls, and specs as they work, and recall them next session with code context. Built for agents, not humans.
